NewsArticle.Title: Circle 5 Armor Quests
NewsArticle.Content: Circle 5 Armor Quests appear. Circle 5 Armor may only be worn by characters level 97 or greater. These armor quests can only be attempted at level 97, because the armor can only be worn at level 97 or greater. Noble versions of these garments can also be gained by recognition for outstanding creativity. [Click here](http://www.darkages.com/2000/atavism/contest.html) to learn about gaining noble garments by your creativity. Noble versions can be worn as low as level 11-31 and do not offer the combat protection. View [all features screenshots.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
